item.title: Father Christmas is 'too white' and his naughty list needs to be 'decolonised', museum claims
item.description: Father Christmas needs to be "decolonised" over "problems" with the "white" festive figure and his naughty list, a museum has claimed.Brighton and Hove Museums also declared more "Mother Christmases" were needed to "show the next generation that men don't have to be in charge".The museum made the claims in a blog post on its website, which suggested Santa should refrain from "judging" children and rewarding them based on a "Western binary of ‘naughty/nice'." item.title: ‘Depressing!’ More than half of Britons slash Christmas present spending amid cost of living crisis

item.title: GB News Advent Calendar - Monday 22nd December 2025
item.description: In today's GB News Advent Calendar, we reflect on centuries and centuries of human rule proving that we are incapable of building the utopia we had hoped for."We don't need more time to prove ourselves. We need a new rule to submit to. This will not be found from within the human race. It must come from outside because the problem is us. "The good news about Christmas is that God has come to the rescue and sent a king to save us." Our Standards: The GB News Editorial Charter
